dataset.name: panel_fe_synthetic
dataset.source: synthetic known-result panel (seed 20260828, 5 firms x 5 years; true beta_value=2, beta_capital=-1; DGP includes firm FE + year FE + residual)

specification.model: invest_it = b1*value_it + b2*capital_it + firm FE + year FE + error_it

canonical_inference.definition: one-way cluster-robust at firm, Stata/reghdfe nested-in-cluster DoF convention
canonical_inference.note: firm FE nested within cluster(firm) redundant for DoF; reference calculator reproduces reghdfe/fixest

note: synthetic known-result benchmark; independent reference calculator (reference.mjs) is the ground truth.
